verses.text: Ayik ix yab'an ix Atalía to toxo ix cham winh yune' ix, haton winhaj rey Ocozías, ix schekan ix satjiel masanil heb' yinhtilal winh rey chi'.

Haxo ix Josaba, yisilkan winhaj rey Joram, schab'il yanab' winhaj rey Ocozías chi', ha' ix ix ik'ankanel winhaj Joás yuninal winhaj Ocozías chi' t'a skal heb' yuninal winh wan smiljicham chi'. Icha chi' ix aj sk'ub'anel winh ix t'a ix Atalía chi'. Ix b'at sk'ub'ejel winh ix yet' jun ix tz'ilan q'uib' winh t'a jun kuarto b'aj ay juntzanh ch'at sik'an, yuj chi' maj miljokcham winhaj Joás chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix k'ub'chajel winh yet' ix tz'ilanq'uib' chi' t'a stemplo Jehová, wake' ab'il ix kan winh ta', yakb'an ayoch ix Atalía yajalil t'a Judá chi'.

Haxo t'a yukil ab'il, a winhaj sat sakerdote Joiada yetb'eyum ix Josaba chi', ix schek winh awtaj heb' yajalil soldado, heb' quereteo yet' heb' stanhwan spalakio winh rey. Ha winh ix ak'anoch heb' t'a yamaq'uil stemplo Jehová. Hata' ix schek winh yak' sti' heb' yik tz'och heb' yet' winh t'a tas nab'il yuj. Ixlajwi chi' ix ch'oxjioch winhaj Joás yuninal winhaj Ocozías chi' t'a heb'.
Elanhchamel ix yal winh t'a heb': Haton tik ol he k'ulok: Ay ex mach ex ol ex ochkan he tanhwej spalakio winh rey t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip,
ayex pax mach ex ol he tanhwej spuertail yik Shur, hanhejtona' ayex mach ex ol he tanhwej spuertail spat heb' stanhwan winh rey. Icha chi' ol aj he kannhej he tanhwej yik malaj mach sk'och ta'.
Ha exxo tzex elkan t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip chi' jun, cha makan tzeyutej he b'a he tanhwan stemplo Jehová t'a stz'eytak winh rey.

Tzex och hoyan t'a spatiktak b'aj ay winh chi', junjun heb' yet'nak syamk'ab' yik owal. Yalnhej mach tz'och t'a he kal b'aj tzolan ex och chi', tojolnhej schami. Yalnhej b'ajtil sb'at winh rey chi', tzex b'at yet' winh, xchi winhaj Joiada chi'.

Ix sk'anab'ajej heb' kapitán chi' tastak ix yal winhaj Joiada chi'. Junjun heb' ix yak'och soldado heb', heb' tz'och stanhwej t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip yet' heb' tz'elkani, ix k'och heb' t'a yichanh winhaj sakerdote Joiada chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an k'een lanza winh yet' k'een smaklab' jul-lab' t'a heb' kapitán chi', haton k'een aykan yuj winhaj rey David t'a yol stemplo Jehová chi'.
Ix och hoyan heb' soldado chi' stanhwan t'a yamaq'uil templo yet' t'a spatiktak altar yet' t'a spatik yichanh winh rey chi'. Junjun heb', yet'nak syamk'ab' heb' yik owal.

Ix yik'anelta winh yuninal winh rey chi' winhaj Joiada chi', ix yak'ank'e korona winh t'a sjolom winh, ix yak'an jun yumal strato Dios winh t'a winh. Ix stob'ank'e akeite winh t'a sjolom winh unin chi', ix yalan winh to reyxo winh. Ixlajwi chi', masanil heb' ix stz'it sk'ab', ix syamanoch heb' yawaji: Niwanokab' yelk'och winh ko reyal, xchi heb'.
Ayik ix yab'an ix Atalía yel yaw heb' winh soldado yet' heb' anima chi' yeq'ui, ix jawi ix t'a stemplo Jehová b'aj ayek' heb' anima smasanil.

Haxo ix yilan ix ayek' winh rey chi', linhanoch winh t'a stz'ey jun oy t'a amak' chi', ichataxon sb'eyb'al heb'. Ha t'a stz'eytak winh rey chi' ayek' heb' yajal yet' heb' tz'ak'anoch sonal heb' sb'itani. Masanil heb' anima chi' stzalaj heb', spu'an sch'aak heb'. Yuj chi' ix snhik'chitejb'at spichul ix, ix el yaw ix: --Pechum ex el yajal a ex tik. Pechum ex el yajal, xchi ix.

Ix yalan winhaj sakerdote Joiada t'a heb' yajalil heb' soldado icha tik: --Ik'ekel ix a ex tzolan ex ek' chi'. Ha mach tz'och tzak'an yuj ix miljokab'chamok, xchi winh. Yujto toxo ix yal winh sakerdote chi' to max yal-laj smiljicham ix t'a yamaq'uil stemplo Jehová.
Yuj chi' ix ik'jielta ix t'a skal heb' chi', ix ik'chajb'at ix b'aj tz'ochk'och sb'e heb' ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej sk'och t'a spalakio winh rey. Hata' ix miljicham ix yuj heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Joiada chi' to sb'okan junok strato winh rey yet' heb' chonhab' to ol ochkan heb' schonhab'ok Jehová. Ix yalanpax winh to ayokab' junok strato winh rey yet' heb' chonhab' chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix smak'anem lanhnaj stemplo Baal heb', ix smak'anpoj juntzanh altar heb' yet' juntzanh yechel. Ix mak'jipaxcham winhaj Matán, sakerdote yaj t'a Baal chi' t'a yichanh juntzanh altar chi'. Ix yak'anoch stanhwumal stemplo Jehová winhaj Joiada chi'.

Ix elta heb' yajalil soldado, heb' quereteo, haton heb' stanhwan winh rey chi' yet' masanil anima. Yaman ix aj yel heb' yet' winh rey t'a yamaq'uil stemplo Jehová, masanto ix k'och heb' t'a palakio. Ha t'a spuertail b'aj ayek' heb' stanhwan palakio chi' ix k'och heb', ix em k'ojan winhaj rey Joás chi' t'a yol sk'ojnub' heb' rey.
Masanil heb' anima, ix tzalajk'e heb', yujto a ix Atalía toxo ix miljicham ix t'a sti' palakio chi'. Icha chi' ix aj skan jun chonhab' chi' t'a junk'olal.
Uke' ab'il sk'inal winhaj rey Joás chi' ayik ix och winh reyal t'a Judá.
